note: acres.acres_affected uses real CSB field acreage, classified by whether the field's centroid LST (post-event MODIS composite) exceeds the crop's stress threshold. observed.prob_below_normal_yield is a SINGLE-SNAPSHOT approximation (one 5-day composite, not a real multi-day distribution) applying the baseline (Tmax-stress-only) model to LST-as-Tmax-proxy - prototype fidelity, not production-grade. forecast.* is the existing Objective 1 routine S2S-forecast prediction for the same county/crop, shown for comparison, not blended.
